verdict.rationale: n8n documents its own Git-based version control: the pricing page lists 'Version control using Git' and the docs have a source-control-and-environments page on pushing and pulling changes. That covers versioning, but the evidence shows no review step or rollback to earlier workflow versions. missing for 10: documented review/approval of workflow changes, documented rollback/restore of prior versions, detail beyond page titles and pricing bullets, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
